skills.title: Regular -ar verbs: yo in the preterite
skills.description: Write the first-person singular preterite of a regular Spanish -ar verb for a completed past action. Exclude spelling changes, irregular verbs, other persons, and other tenses.

exercises.explanation: For yo in the preterite, replace -ar with -é: cantar → canté.
For yo in the preterite, replace -ar with -é: bailar → bailé.
For yo in the preterite, replace -ar with -é: tomar → tomé.
